caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers positioned at an angle against a plain, off-white background. The chest has a reddish-brown coloration consistent throughout its surfaces, including the front, sides, top, and visible portions of the legs. Its front is organized into four rows: the top row has two small adjacent drawers, while the three lower rows each contain a single, larger drawer. Each drawer is fitted with two horizontal wooden handles, also colored reddish-brown, for a total of eight handles. The three larger drawers are further detailed with a small yellow-green keyhole centered between their handles. The chest stands on four short, curved legs, and the surface of the wood includes visible grain patterns that suggest a polished finish. There is a small, neat inscription in the lower right corner of the drawing that reads "Joseph Triscadanti K.C. MO."
title: Cherry Chest of Drawers
